experience.reason: Emotional and experiential character distinguishes otherwise similar premises.

humor.reason: Amount and mode of humor distinguish the viewing experience.

themes.reason: Narrative centrality of a subject contributes to content resemblance; incidental occurrence does not imply a high value.

genres.reason: Retain genre membership for discovery and filters. Broad and nested genre labels overlap the selected tone, themes, engines and treatment; omit this additional taxonomy from default vector distance.

narrative_engines.reason: The activity driving the plot distinguishes works with similar subjects.

tropes.reason: Retain precise plot devices for targeted matching and spoiler-aware explanations; omit the full trope inventory from default distance.

relationships.include: romantic_development established_couple breakup_or_divorce partner_bereavement love_triangle forbidden_romance friendship mentor_mentee rivalry forced_proximity adversaries_cooperate found_family family_conflict intergenerational generational_trauma parent_child siblings caregiver_dependent human_animal_companionship coercive_relationship coercive_group_control
relationships.reason: Central interpersonal dynamics shape content resemblance beyond genre.
relationships.excluded_reason: Retain the more specific romantic, demographic or institutional subtype for targeted matching; avoid additional votes alongside the selected broader relationship dynamic.

characters.include: ensemble antihero morally_ambiguous_cast transformation_arc intellectual_problem_solver detective_lead workplace_team family_business unaccompanied_children teen_peer_group clandestine_groups
characters.reason: Character organization, agency in the premise and social units shape the story.
characters.excluded_reason: Retain protagonist demographics and demographic agency for explicit representation queries and explanations; do not make demographic overlap a default general-similarity signal.

representation.reason: Preserve explicit representation facts for preference-directed discovery; identity overlap alone is not a default resemblance criterion.

world.include: advanced_technology magic simulation virtual_reality parallel_worlds time_travel time_loop dystopian_society post_apocalyptic spacefaring robots myth_and_folklore
world.reason: Consequential world premises distinguish the kind of story, independently of incidental props.
world.excluded_reason: Past/future travel direction remains queryable metadata; time_travel already represents the shared mechanism.

world_treatment.reason: How the world is presented affects resemblance independently of its premise.
world_treatment.excluded_reason: Lore dependence describes prerequisite viewing knowledge; retain in viewing context.

settings.reason: Retain location centrality and separate occurrence for explicit setting-based search. This proposal prioritizes dramatic and experiential resemblance over a full location taxonomy.

occupations.reason: Retain occupational centrality for targeted discovery; work themes, social units and plot engines supply broader default resemblance.

activities.reason: Retain specific activity centrality for targeted content matching. An activity may be decisive for a requested match without being a mandatory coordinate for every title.

sports.reason: Retain each sport and its centrality for sport-specific retrieval; competition, character transformation and action treatment contribute to default resemblance.

entities.reason: Retain creatures, animals and vehicles for targeted content matching rather than giving every entity class a default coordinate.

storytelling.include: plot_velocity gradual_development intrigue plot_complexity interpretive_ambiguity twist_frequency twist_impact nonlinearity multiple_timelines multiple_viewpoints unreliable_narration unreliable_reality self_reference fourth_wall_breaking voiceover dream_sequences observational_mode slice_of_life exposition_load information_withholding philosophical_inquiry formal_challenge
storytelling.reason: Narrative form, pacing and information delivery shape the experience.
storytelling.excluded_reason: Educational intent and intertextual references remain descriptive metadata; reference recognition should not be required for the general vector.

stakes.reason: The scale and urgency of consequences differentiate story experience.
stakes.excluded_reason: Planetary and cosmic scope remain targeted metadata; do not grant increasingly large speculative stakes additional default coordinates.

dialogue.include: density dependence monologues overlap naturalistic_delivery theatrical_delivery
dialogue.reason: Spoken delivery and dialogue structure distinguish form.
dialogue.excluded_reason: Jargon and multilingual exchange remain metadata and accessibility/context inputs rather than default resemblance coordinates.

aesthetics.include: gothic noir retro minimalism stylization surrealism psychedelia grotesquerie camp ironic_distance intimacy spectacle immersion
aesthetics.reason: Perceptible aesthetic treatment changes resemblance across subjects.
aesthetics.excluded_reason: Cyberpunk and steampunk remain targeted aesthetic labels; selected technology/world and visual-treatment dimensions describe broader components without extra composite-label votes.

visuals.include: vibrant_palette muted_palette warm_color cool_color low_key_lighting high_key_lighting high_contrast long_takes handheld_motion symmetry production_design_detail
visuals.reason: Broad visible treatment contributes to stylistic resemblance.
visuals.excluded_reason: Retain fine technical, palette and composition details for targeted aesthetic search; production techniques must not be inferred solely from appearance.

action.include: hand_to_hand martial_arts_choreography grappling gunplay blade_combat superpowered_combat chases large_battles gritty_combat stylized_violence realistic_violence
action.reason: Action form and presentation distinguish the experience when action is important.
action.excluded_reason: Fine choreography subtypes remain targeted metadata alongside broader selected action forms.

horror_modes.reason: The source and mode of horror meaningfully distinguish experiences beyond general fear intensity.

sound.include: design_prominence ambient_soundscapes silence sparse_score audio_startles music_dependence musical_numbers
sound.reason: Perceptible sonic and musical treatment affects the experience.
sound.excluded_reason: Retain sound provenance, performance context and specialized devices as targeted metadata; dependency for accessibility remains viewing context.

music_styles.reason: Retain specific musical styles for soundtrack-focused discovery; broad musical prominence and integration remain in the fingerprint.

ending.include: conflict_resolution interpretive_openness emotional_closure happiness tragedy bittersweetness
ending.reason: Resolution and emotional destination shape resemblance; keep these dimensions hidden from spoiler-free explanations.
ending.excluded_reason: Specific ending devices remain spoiler-sensitive metadata; sequel dependence belongs in viewing context.

series.reason: Keep show-only structure separately; a universal movie/show vector must not encode movie non-applicability as zero.

viewing_demands.reason: Sensory load describes the experience itself.
viewing_demands.excluded_reason: Prerequisite knowledge, attention and access demands guide viewing decisions separately from general resemblance.

viewing_affordances.reason: Situational suitability guides recommendation ranking or filtering separately.

evaluations.reason: Quality judgments guide ranking separately; similar execution quality does not imply similar content or experience.
